lead_headline: Metaflow clears a five-issue backlog before dawn; Claude Code accumulates a prompt-cache inheritance problem worth watching
lead_body: Metaflow absorbed four merged PRs in a tight early-morning window, closing bugs ranging from an orphaned-process race condition to a Windows SIGALRM crash in the timeout decorator. Claude Code, meanwhile, stayed unpatched while a structurally notable report landed: subagents are inheriting the parent's prompt cache at roughly 150K tokens, producing what the reporter terms plan-mode bleed and self-poisoning hallucinations.
lead_article:
Metaflow was the only project with meaningful movement today. Four PRs merged in a tight early-morning window: the redundant `_sfn_host_network` variable that had been hardcoded to `False` in the Tiltfile local setup was removed outright, closing the underlying bug; the Cards UI picked up a typos-and-syntax-errors pass; the CI configuration gained workflow concurrency to reduce runner contention; and a missing Airflow dependency quietly appeared in the README. Five issues closed alongside those merges, including a race condition in subprocess termination that was leaving orphaned processes after timeouts or SIGINT, a Windows crash in the `@timeout` decorator tracing back to SIGALRM being Unix-only, and the longstanding gap where `@catch` couldn't be applied to `foreach` split steps. Config files rejecting YAML in favour of JSON-only input also closed, as did the request for standardised GitHub issue templates.

Claude Code surfaced a cluster of issues worth watching. The most structurally interesting: a report that subagents are inheriting the parent's prompt cache — roughly 150K tokens — producing what the reporter calls plan-mode bleed and self-poisoning hallucinations. Separately, an Opus 4.7 Korean output regression arrived with an unusually detailed in-vivo self-diagnosis from the model itself, flagged as related to an earlier issue. The Bun 1.3.14 GC segfault on AMD Ryzen Linux and the broken `/schedule` URL rounding out the bug side. Everything else — Astro, Hydrogen, the AI SDK, Workflow SDK, Dispatch, Gemma.cpp, Mantis — was silent.
